reason: Preserves every original binary64 numeric equality. Base-two Math.pow calls with nonnegative integer exponents are executed by a general multiply-by-two loop, retaining subtraction and left-associated products. This is a numeric-domain adaptation, not the general Math.pow API or dynamic conversion protocols. Finite nonzero and infinity equality is checked by result bits; supplemental cases are separate.
